name: Medical Device Innovation Corp.
old_description: In today’s competitive and entrepreneurial marketplace, the ability and vision to accelerate ideas from concept to market is instrumental in success and long-term profitability.  From validation and FDA regulatory filings to clinical trials, our integrated approach helps clients launch successful products and maximize profitability.
about:
Medical Device Innovation Corp. (MDIC) is based in Irvine, California, where it provides consulting and product development services for the medical device industry. The company focuses on accelerating ideas from concept to market through an integrated approach that spans validation, regulatory filings, and clinical trials.

MDIC offers a range of services including innovation management, ideation, intellectual property assessment, product development, design validation planning, regulatory filings (510(k), PMA, De Novo), clinical trial management, financial analysis, and supply chain setup. The firm also assists with prototyping, proof-of-concept validation, FDA design control and quality system regulation (QSR) documentation (DHF, DMR, DHR), commercial product design, manufacturing setup, and FDA validation.

The company serves medical device manufacturers, startups, and entrepreneurs seeking to bring new products to market. Its clients include organizations needing support with FDA clearance, clinical evidence generation, cost-of-goods reduction, and intellectual property strategy.

MDIC emphasizes an integrated, roadmap-driven approach that combines strategy, project management, and regulatory expertise to help clients maximize profitability and accelerate time to market.

name: Medical Products Laboratories
old_description: Medical Products Laboratories, Inc. is a full service contract manufacturer of human and veterinary pharmaceuticals,
about:
Medical Products Laboratories, Inc. (MPL) was founded in 1936 in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company has operated as a contract manufacturer for nearly nine decades, though the INPUT does not specify its ownership structure or founders.

MPL provides full-service contract manufacturing and packaging for human and veterinary pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and nutritional supplements. Its capabilities span formulation development, production of liquid, semi-solid, and solid dosage forms, and a broad range of packaging formats including blisters, packets, pouches, bottles, jars, pumps, sprayers, tubes, syringes, and aerosols. The company maintains a diverse equipment fleet and adds new machinery regularly; its engineering team also fabricates custom tooling for unique packaging needs. Regulatory and compliance teams support clients from pilot scale through commercial production.

The company serves the pharmaceutical, veterinary, dietary supplement, and medical device industries, supplying both human and animal health markets. Customers range from drug and supplement brands to medical device firms seeking turnkey development and manufacturing.

MPL emphasizes its turnkey approach, covering the entire product life cycle from concept to end-stage production. It highlights exceptional value and flexibility derived from its extensive in-house equipment, continuous capital investment, custom tooling capability, and dedicated regulatory guidance.

name: Medicatech USA
old_description: Medicatech USA® is a leading manufacturer and distributor dedicated to providing high-quality radiographic solutions.
about:
Medicatech USA was founded in 2005 in Anaheim, California, as a manufacturer and distributor of radiographic solutions. The company began with a focus on digital radiography systems for both human medical and veterinary applications.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures a range of radiographic equipment including straight-arm and U-arm systems (MasteRad MX30, MX30C, MX40), mobile C-arms (Mini-X), flat-panel detectors (MasterX and EXPRIMER series), X-ray generators (NexGen 900 series), and portable veterinary units (ClearRay 1700, 2000, SIUI). It also develops the Voyance® image acquisition software and PACS platform, featuring the ClairVoyance™ deep-learning algorithm for bone suppression. Medicatech reports 42,785 powered facilities and 11,378 dealers served.

Medicatech serves human medical radiology, veterinary radiology, chiropractic imaging, and dental imaging markets. Its customers include hospitals, clinics, chiropractors, veterinarians, and a network of dealers across the United States.

The company emphasizes American-made manufacturing, rapid installation (under 15 minutes), US-based phone support, and custom engineering to modify products for specific clinical needs. Its stated mission is to deliver seamless, reliable radiology solutions that improve clinical efficiency and patient outcomes.

name: Medicreations
old_description: Uncompromising results. Empowering your growth — without sacrificing value.
about:
Medicreations is based in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company was founded by professionals with decades of combined experience in medical aesthetics and engineering, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. No ownership structure such as family, veteran, or woman-owned status is publicly stated. The founders recognized the challenges aesthetics professionals faced—lackluster service, unreliable warranties, and devices that did not deliver consistent ROI—and set out to build a different kind of device company.

Medicreations designs and manufactures a line of energy-based aesthetic devices at its FDA-audited facility in Las Vegas. The portfolio includes the MediSpa, a seven-modality facial platform; the Velo, an air-cooled CO2 laser for resurfacing and scarring; the MediDiode, a diode laser for hair removal across all skin types; the MediYag, a dual-wavelength Q-switched Nd:YAG system for pigmentation and tattoo removal; and the MediLight, an IPL platform with five wavelength filters. The company emphasizes USA-made quality, minimal consumables, and fast treatment times.

The devices are sold to medical aesthetics practices, medspas, dermatology clinics, and plastic surgery centers across the United States. Practitioners seeking ROI-driven technology and reliable support form the core customer base. The company highlights that its technologies power treatments for acne, anti-aging, skin tightening, pigmentation, tattoo removal, and hair removal.

Medicreations differentiates itself with a two-year warranty on every device—an uncommon promise in the industry—along with included training and ongoing support. All equipment is built in an ISO-certified, FDA-compliant facility, and the company stresses durable, USA-made construction, limited consumables, and minimal maintenance to lower operating costs for clinic owners.

name: Medway Plastics Corporation
old_description: We’re a company with Sustainable Plastic Injection Molding & Design since 1974,  working with the best machinery & tools. You can find us in Long Beach, California & Round Rock, Austin, Texas.
about:
Medway Plastics Corporation was founded in 1974 in Long Beach, California, and remains family-owned. The company operates a second facility in Pflugerville, Texas, near Austin. No founder names are disclosed in the source material.

The company specializes in custom plastic injection molding and design, offering single- and multi-cavity tooling for small, medium, and large parts. Its Long Beach plant runs 26 injection presses, 16 of which are 500 tons or larger, while the Pflugerville site operates four presses. Medway processes both commodity and engineering resins and recycles all plastic scrap back into production. A distinctive feature is its on-site electric co-generation system: three 375-kilowatt natural-gas generators with absorption chillers that supply electricity, recover heat for mold-cooling refrigeration, and provide whole-plant backup power.

Medway serves a broad range of industrial customers but does not name specific sectors in its public materials. The company also develops and sells proprietary products under its own brand.

Sustainability and energy independence are central to Medway's positioning. The co-generation system has operated for roughly 11 years, and the firm has added Thermal Control Solution radiant heating systems to its largest presses to further reduce energy consumption. The company emphasizes that its sustainable processes and material choices are driven by both environmental and cost-control objectives.

name: Melnick Metal Works Inc.
old_description: Since 1960, we’ve provided expert metal fabrication for residential, commercial, and industrial projects—built to last, made to fit.
about:
Melnick Metal Works Inc. has operated from Bristol, Connecticut since its founding in 1960. The third-generation, family-owned business began as a metal fabrication shop serving the local area and has continued under family stewardship for over six decades.

The company provides custom metal fabrication across a range of processes: cutting, bending, and shaping sheet metal for prototypes and production runs; building commercial and residential kitchen hoods in stainless steel; fabricating automotive brackets, panels, and structural parts for restoration and custom builds; producing railings for stairs, safety barriers, and decorative applications; constructing metal roofs and awnings for weather protection; manufacturing industrial components such as machine parts, enclosures, and structural elements; and creating architectural metalwork including decorative panels and structural components for buildings and public spaces. The shop's team of fabricators brings more than 100 years of combined experience to projects of varying scale.

Customers span residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. The company has supplied hoods to restaurants, railings to homes and businesses, automotive parts to classic-car restorers, and structural components to manufacturers and construction firms. A testimonial from New England Machine Tools references repeated intricate fabrications, while other clients note work on a Wagoneer rocker panel and custom hoods.

Melnick Metal Works emphasizes its experienced workforce, on-time delivery, and ability to handle jobs from small residential tasks to large industrial projects. The family-owned structure is cited as a foundation for its commitment to quality and long-term customer relationships.

name: Mercury Electronics
old_description: We are the leading provider of electrical/electronic contract manufacturing
about:
Mercury Electronics, based in Seven Valleys, Pennsylvania, has been in continuous operation since 1946. The company provides electrical and electronic contract manufacturing services for commercial and military industries worldwide.

The company produces custom electrical and electronic assemblies including cable assemblies, wire harnesses, panel wiring, and electromechanical assemblies. Its facility handles projects from simple cut-and-stripped wire to complex control panels and enclosures. Manufacturing processes include cutting, stripping, terminating, splicing, crimping, soldering, ultrasonic welding, potting, encapsulation, wire marking, over-braiding, EMI shielding, and watertight harness assembly. The company supports prototype, low-volume, and high-volume production with just-in-time delivery.

Mercury serves industries such as defense, heavy equipment, transportation, and HVAC, primarily supplying OEM manufacturers. Its customer base spans commercial and military applications globally.

The company’s stated mission is to exceed customer expectations by delivering superior quality products on time at the lowest possible cost. It emphasizes a 100% customer satisfaction goal, backed by an engineering team averaging 31 years of experience, ISO 9001/AS9100 certification, UL recognition for wiring harnesses, and an IPC-A-620 certified trainer on staff.

name: Mermar Electronics
old_description: ISO/AS9100 electronics manufacturer offering cable harness assembly plus PCB work
about:
Mermar Electronics is a contract electronics manufacturer based in Hesperia, California, founded in 1999. The company provides PCB fabrication, assembly, cable harness, box build, and electro-mechanical assembly services from a single facility in the High Desert region.

The company operates a state-of-the-art assembly plant capable of surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed-technology PCB assembly, including fine-pitch placement down to 01005/0201 components and BGA rework. It offers PCB fabrication, design, quick-turn prototyping as fast as 24 hours, and full box-build integration with testing, packaging, and labeling. Services cover prototype to high-volume production runs, with both consignment and turnkey material management options.

Mermar serves original equipment manufacturers in aerospace, medical, dental, therapeutic, telecommunications, industrial, renewable energy, kiosk, and guitar pedalboard markets. Its aerospace work is backed by AS9100 Rev D certification and ITAR registration, while medical assemblies follow ISO 9001:2015 and RoHS compliance.

The company emphasizes rapid turnaround, advertising same-day and next-day quick-turn assembly, 24-hour prototype builds, and a one-stop turnkey model that eliminates multi-vendor coordination. All products are built in the USA under a quality system that includes AOI, X-ray inspection, and adherence to IPC standards.

name: Metal Fab Engineering
old_description: Crafting Outstanding Solutions and Creating Remarkable Products for More than Five Decades
about:
Metal Fab Engineering operates from Winamac, Indiana, where it was founded in 1976 as a small fabrication shop by Paul Ezra and his wife Mary Lou. Now in its third generation of family ownership, the company has grown into a full-service metal fabrication partner for OEM manufacturers across the Midwest and beyond.

The shop runs four automated lasers capable of cutting carbon steel up to 1 inch, stainless steel up to 3/4 inch, and aluminum up to 1/2 inch. Its forming department includes over 20 press brakes, highlighted by a 225-ton press with an 8-foot bed and a 175-ton CNC unit with 12-foot beds. Robotic and manual welding cells handle welded subassemblies and final assemblies, while an in-house powder coating line provides durable finishes for low-to-mid volume runs. The company also offers value-add engineering, CAD-based design consulting, and a domestic-first procurement service. Annual output reaches hundreds of thousands of parts.

Metal Fab Engineering serves OEM manufacturers in a variety of industrial sectors, though specific verticals are not publicly listed. Its customer base includes companies that require precision laser-cut components, formed brackets, welded frames, and finished assemblies delivered through a single-source supply chain.

The company emphasizes problem-solving expertise backed by more than six granted patents and multiple pending applications. Its family-owned structure drives a culture of integrity and long-term partnership, recognized by a 2023 Safety Award of Honor from the Fabricators & Manufacturers Association. A domestic-first sourcing platform and in-house finishing further differentiate its offering.
